items.title: Pay chimney renovation invoice
items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Betrag binnen 14 Tagen ab dem Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug.
items.computation: Period runs from the invoice date 19.11.2026. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (the invoice date) is not counted, so counting starts on 20.11.2026. A 14-day period counted this way ends, per §188 Abs. 1 BGB, 14 days after the invoice date, i.e. on 03.12.2026. This is a payment owed to a private company based in NW (the payer's own Land per §§269, 270 Abs. 4 BGB), so NW public holidays apply. 03.12.2026 is a Thursday and not a public holiday in NW, so no shift under §193 BGB is needed. Due date: 2026-12-03.
